note: Published reference metrics plus illustrative, user-editable percentage changes. These are not predictions from the graph, and each metric covers only the stated scope. Do not add benefits across outcomes.

O1.metric: Deaths attributable to bacterial antimicrobial resistance
O1.scope: Global bacterial AMR only; not all preventable deaths
O1.note: The reference is 1.14 million deaths attributable to resistance, not the larger 4.71 million associated-death estimate. A 10% reduction of this reference burden would equal 114,000 lives per year. This does not establish that the linked math can deliver that reduction.

O2.metric: Average retail electricity price, all sectors
O2.scope: United States, all-sector average retail electricity price
O2.source_name: US EIA, United States Electricity Profile 2024
O2.note: EIA reports 12.94 cents per kWh. Multiplying by 10 converts this to $129.40 per MWh. This is a historical annual retail average, not a current quote or a wholesale generation cost.

O3.unit: USD per metric tonne of wheat
O3.metric: US hard red winter wheat, Gulf export price
O3.scope: One wheat benchmark; not the price of all food or fertilizer
O3.source_name: World Bank Pink Sheet, October 2026, wheat US HRW
O3.note: The September 2026 monthly benchmark is $347 per metric tonne. A lower benchmark price does not translate one-for-one into household food bills.

O4.scope: Airlines only; excludes shipping and road freight
O4.note: IATA reports $252 billion in fuel costs for 2025. The scenario holds fuel prices and traffic fixed and treats the percentage as a fuel-expenditure reduction. It does not model rebound, hedging, implementation cost, or shipping.

O5.scope: Natural-disaster economic losses, including uninsured property; not all infrastructure spending
O5.source_name: Munich Re, natural disaster figures for 2025
O5.note: The reported 2025 total is $224 billion. This is one year's observed loss estimate, not a forward expected-loss estimate. A fractional reduction is an illustrative avoided-loss case.

O6.scope: Aon estimate of global reinsurer capital at 30 September 2024; not all financial-system buffers or annual premiums
O6.note: Aon estimates $715 billion in reinsurer capital. The scenario assumes the required capital stock could fall by the chosen percentage at equivalent protection. It is not annual income, annual savings, or a conclusion about permitted capital requirements.

O7.metric: Mean nuclear-reactor construction time for 2024 grid connections
O7.scope: Seven reactors connected in 2024, first concrete to grid connection; excludes earlier planning and licensing
O7.source_name: World Nuclear Association, World Nuclear Performance Report 2025
O7.note: The reported mean is 114 months, converted to 9.5 years. The sample contains seven reactors, with construction times from 61 to 204 months. This is not a general drug, aircraft, or certification timeline.

O8.unit: GJ per tonne of crude steel
O8.scope: Worldsteel reporting organisations, representative materials-energy metric; not compute prices or all materials
O8.note: The reported 2024 global-average energy intensity is 20.95 GJ per tonne of crude steel. This metric illustrates the materials part of this outcome. It does not convert energy savings into dollar savings or represent compute cost.

O9.metric: Global healthy life expectancy at birth
O9.scope: WHO global healthy life expectancy at birth; a population indicator, not an individual's prognosis
O9.source_name: WHO Global Health Observatory, life expectancy and life tables
O9.note: WHO reports 62.8 healthy years in 2023. The percentage case is a hypothetical proportional increase in this population indicator, not a forecast of an aging intervention or an individual health gain.

O10.scope: Energy-related CO2, including industrial processes; excludes land-use emissions and does not measure carbon removal
O10.source_name: IEA, Global Energy Review 2025, CO2 Emissions
O10.note: The 2024 reference total is 37.8 Gt CO2. A percentage reduction gives avoided emissions relative to that reference year, not verified carbon removals.
